0022600117.text: The 76ers (3-0, first in the Atlantic and second in the East, 2-0 at home, on a three-game win streak) host the Detroit Pistons (2-0, first in the Central and first in the East, on a two-game win streak) in their fourth game of the season. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), Joel Embiid (heel), Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and VJ Edgecombe (abdomen, bruise), while Detroit is missing Ausar Thompson (ankle, sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring, strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and in 2025-26 the 76ers lost the season series 0-4, including a 116-93 loss in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026, their most recent meeting.
